verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a native iOS/iPadOS Git client that runs on the user's own device, so self-hosting a server deployment of the core product does not apply to this kind of product. Its documented support for private GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea instances, and for Linux, BSD or Synology servers acting as hosts, concerns connecting to self-hosted Git servers. That is a different capability and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
